svg.title: DHCT-GAN — detailed architecture
svg.text: Batch x input channels x samples.
CNN stem; encoder levels with local and global attention.
Process deepest features before splitting into decoder
A sigmoid gate combines clean and input-minus-artifact.
forward returns the artifact decoder prediction.
Fused clean is retained for the training objective.
Noisy waveform → Shared CNN / Transformer · flow
Shared CNN / Transformer → Shared bottleneck · flow
Shared bottleneck → Clean decoder branch · flow
Shared bottleneck → Artifact decoder branch · flow
Shared CNN / Transformer → Clean decoder branch · skip: Matching feature levels
Shared CNN / Transformer → Artifact decoder branch · skip: Matching feature levels
Clean decoder branch → Gated clean fusion · merge
Artifact decoder branch → Gated clean fusion · merge
Noisy waveform → Gated clean fusion · skip: Noisy input
Artifact decoder branch → Returned waveform · flow: Inference output
Discriminators and adversarial objectives are training-only; they are not in the inference signal
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and
